exposure: past surgical history (procedures likely to cause adhesive disease)
anatomic location of prior past surgical history (pelvic, abdominal, abdominal+pelvic)
total number of prior open surgeries
cohort: 1256 women who underwent hysterectomy at a single, tertiary, academic health system from May 2016 to May 2017.
finding: Prior abdominopelvic surgery is associated with worse perioperative outcome measures, including increased length of stay, greater estimated blood loss, and more readmissions, in women undergoing hysterectomy.
